Description 
 Key Responsibilities include, but are not limited to:  
 • Provide application design guidance and consultation, utilizing a thorough understanding of applicable technology, tools and existing designs. 
 • Determines and implements the most efficient and cost effective solution. 
 • Provide guidance on latest technology trends and future directions 
 • Analyze highly complex business requirements. 
 • Create technical specifications to design or redesign complex computer platforms and applications. 
 • Analyze problems outlined by Business Systems Analysts in terms of detailed technology requirements and capabilities. 
 • Uses Best Practices in UI/UX coding and promote high quality code 
 • Verify program logic by overseeing the preparation of test data, testing and debugging of programs. 
 • Use Agile SCRUM to deliver solutions with high level of flexibility and adaptability. 
 • Support overall systems testing and the migration of platforms and applications to production. 
 • Develop documentation standards, procedures and approval hierarchies. 

   HTML, Javascript, Ajax, XSL, Ajax, REST API, Agile 

 Multiple Openings for GC/Citizen
